title: Houthi militia missile aimed at southern Saudi Arabia intercepted, Saudi-led coalition says
text:
Houthi militia missile aimed at southern Saudi Arabia intercepted, Saudi-led coalition says - TRT World LIVE TV POLITICS TÜRKİYE WAR ON GAZA BIZTECH INFOGRAPHICS FEATURES OPINION WAR ON IRAN WAR ON IRAN 1 min read Houthi militia missile aimed at southern Saudi Arabia intercepted, Saudi-led coalition says Saudi authorities report drone interceptions in the southern region. Share Saudi Arabia downs three Houthi militia missiles amid escalating Yemen conflict. / Reuters Archive The Saudi-led coalition said on Friday that it intercepted and destroyed a ballistic missile launched by Houthi militia toward southern Saudi Arabia.
 Coalition spokesman Turki al Maliki announced the interception in a statement on X.
 Authorities also reported drone interceptions in the southern region and issued emergency alerts in several southern areas.
